task.topic: In adults hospitalized with acute lower gastrointestinal bleeding, does colonoscopy within 24 hours reduce persistent or recurrent bleeding compared with elective colonoscopy after 24 hours?

pico.population: Adults hospitalized with acute lower gastrointestinal bleeding or hematochezia
pico.exposure: Colonoscopy within 24 hours of presentation or admission
pico.comparator: Elective or standard colonoscopy after 24 hours, with permitted standard diagnostic management
outcomes: Source-reported persistent or recurrent lower gastrointestinal bleeding after the index examination

outcome.description: Source-reported persistent or recurrent lower gastrointestinal bleeding after the index examination

candidate_capture_policy.record_scope: one source-reported eligible arm-level outcome per report

targets.quantitative_use_policy: Extract events and denominators in both randomized arms, the source definition, follow-up window, and a verified source location. Do not copy an RR from a review forest plot.

extraction.model_selection_policy: Preserve every source-reported candidate; no study or effect selection occurs in extraction.
extraction.evidence_requirements: Transcribe only source-supported data, preserve exact evidence, and do not calculate, pool, choose an analysis record, or infer missing values.
